author.name: Tarun Mankar
author.tagline: Tools for the Overthinking Mind & the Dysregulated Nervous System
author.bio: Tarun Mankar writes at the intersection of somatic psychology, nervous system science, and behavioral change. His books are designed to be felt — not just read.

books.title: Stop Spiraling
books.subtitle: The Anxiously Attached Person's Daily Toolkit for Calmer Relationships
books.hook: Sent a text 45 minutes ago and your chest is still burning?
books.hook_sub: Your nervous system is stuck in a threat loop — and reading more affirmations won't fix it.
books.description: Check your phone constantly when a text goes unanswered? Overthink shifts in tone and worry closeness will disappear? Your nervous system is stuck in a hyperactive threat loop. Stop Spiraling is your practical toolkit to break the cycle of anxious attachment — regulate your nervous system, tolerate uncertainty, and communicate clearly using honest relationship scripts that build closeness.

books.title: Somatic Pacing
books.subtitle: The High-Achiever's Daily Guide to Reclaiming Focus and Energy Without Burning Out
books.hook: Why that 3 PM espresso is making your brain fog worse, not better.
books.hook_sub: You're not lazy. You're running on an empty nervous system that no caffeine can fix.
books.description: Stare at your screen for hours, physically exhausted yet mentally wired? Run on caffeine and collapse at night? Your nervous system is stuck in a chronic threat loop. Somatic Pacing is your body-first blueprint to reclaim daily focus and energy — learn sixty-second resets, vagus nerve techniques, and energy boundaries to clear afternoon brain fog without sacrificing output.

books.title: Healing The Scarcity Mindset
books.subtitle: A Daily Guide to Releasing Money Anxiety and Rewiring Your Scarcity Trauma
books.hook: Checking your bank balance makes you feel physically sick?
books.hook_sub: It's not a budgeting problem. Your body learned to fear money before your mind did.
books.description: Stare at your bank app, physically frozen with anxiety? Feel a tight chest when paying routine bills? You aren't bad with money — your body is stuck in a survival loop. This audiobook translates somatic regulation into simple everyday financial habits. Learn the science of interoceptive alarms, use sixty-second nervous system resets before opening spreadsheets, and expand your capacity to hold wealth.

books.title: Dopamine Reset and Deep Focus
books.subtitle: Reclaiming Attention, Ending Brain Fog, and Mastering Unshakable Discipline
books.hook: Why you can't read 3 pages without picking up your phone.
books.hook_sub: Your attention isn't broken — it's been hijacked. This is the neuroscience of taking it back.
books.description: Constantly checking your phone, struggling to focus, or feeling mentally exhausted by midday? Modern digital environments are engineered to hijack your brain's reward pathways. This audiobook gives you a clear roadmap to reclaim your mind — practical bodily tools, digital hygiene protocols, and daily habits to lower your dopamine baseline and restore effortless concentration.

books.title: The Courage to Disappoint
books.subtitle: Choosing Your Peace Over People's Expectations
books.hook: You say yes when your entire body is screaming no.
books.hook_sub: You lie awake agonizing over whether you offended someone by speaking up. That's not kindness — that's a survival reflex.
books.description: Exhausted from carrying everyone else's emotional baggage? The Courage to Disappoint is a body-first guide to breaking free from chronic people-pleasing. Discover practical scripts, real-time nervous system regulation exercises, and deep psychological tools to stop over-explaining, dismantle boundary guilt, deliver clean unapologetic refusals, and reclaim your personal sovereignty.

books.title: Wired for Security
books.subtitle: Rewiring Anxious Attachment, Silencing Relationship Hypervigilance, and Finding Peace in Love
books.hook: An unanswered text sends you into a spiral of panic?
books.hook_sub: You aren't crazy — your nervous system is trapped in attachment alarm. Here's the exit.
books.description: Your somatic, science-backed roadmap to healing anxious attachment. Provides practical, in-the-moment tools to silence relationship hypervigilance, calm acute panic in ninety seconds, and step off the exhausting pursuer-distancer treadmill. Learn to communicate needs with grounded vulnerability, distinguish genuine red flags from internal anxiety triggers, and build deep peaceful intimacy.

books.title: Mastering the Emotional Storm
books.subtitle: Taming Emotional Flooding, Calming Instant Reactivity, and Finding Grounding Under Pressure
books.hook: Minor annoyances make your blood boil in seconds?
books.hook_sub: A flash of anger makes you say things you instantly regret. That's not your character — it's a survival hijack.
books.description: Your somatic, science-backed roadmap to regaining complete self-command. Reveals how to halt emotional flooding at the neurochemical level before it dictates your words. Detect subtle bodily warning signs, cool down sympathetic surges in ninety seconds with vagal resets, and replace instant defensiveness with unshakable inner poise.

books.title: The Procrastination Loop
books.subtitle: Breaking the Cycle of Delay, Self-Sabotage, and the Fear Hidden Underneath
books.hook: You keep telling yourself you'll start tomorrow.
books.hook_sub: But tomorrow becomes next week. The guilt hardens into shame. You're not lazy — you're stuck in a loop built to protect you from fear.
books.description: The emotional and neurological truth behind chronic delay: it is not a time problem, it is a fear problem. Through somatic tools, psychological clarity, and a compassionate identity reset, this book breaks the avoidance-shame cycle at its root — and helps you finally become someone who starts, finishes, and follows through.

books.title: Thawing the Freeze
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Breaking Functional Freeze, Emotional Numbness, and Living in Low-Power Mode
books.hook: You look functional on the outside but feel completely numb inside.
books.hook_sub: Like you're watching your life through thick glass. That's not depression — that's your nervous system's emergency brake.
books.description: You wake up, answer emails, smile at coworkers — but on the inside you feel flat, detached, and numb. Your nervous system has entered functional freeze. Thawing the Freeze offers a compassionate roadmap out of dorsal vagal shutdown — gently melt physical numbness, expand your emotional capacity, reclaim natural motivation, and rekindle genuine intimacy without hustle culture.

books.title: The Inability to Rest
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Calming the Panic of Doing Nothing, Chronic Busyness, and Downtime Anxiety
books.hook: You sit down to relax and your chest tightens with unexplained panic.
books.hook_sub: You compulsively scrub counters, unable to survive ten minutes of stillness. You tell yourself you're driven. But you don't know how to stop.
books.description: Your nervous system equates stillness with danger. Chronic busyness is not ambition — it is survival armor. This audiobook reveals how to re-engage your vagal brake, disarm downtime guilt, dissolve the fawning reflex, and protect your white space without apologizing. You do not need to earn your right to pause.

books.title: The Midnight Nervous System
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Calming Midnight Panic, Sleep Dread, and the Overactive Night Mind
books.hook: Your head hits the pillow and your heart starts pounding.
books.hook_sub: You snap awake at 3 AM calculating how many hours until dawn. You've tried everything. Your body treats the dark like an interrogation room.
books.description: Your autonomic nervous system perceives bedtime as a threat. Grounded in polyvagal neuroscience and somatic medicine, this audiobook provides lying-down physical resets, clock-panic interrupts, and vagal downshifting protocols to discharge trapped motor tension without fighting your mind. You do not need to force sleep — just teach your body it is safe to rest.

books.title: The Shame Collapse
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Releasing Chronic Unworthiness, Dissolving the Not Enough Voice, and Reclaiming Your Right to Take Up Space
books.hook: Someone calls your name and your body collapses inward before your mind registers the sentence.
books.hook_sub: You apologize reflexively for simply existing in a room. That's not humility — that's a biological survival reflex.
books.description: Toxic shame is a biological survival reflex, not a moral failure. Grounded in polyvagal neuroscience and somatic medicine, this audiobook provides immediate physical interrupts, rib-expansion breathing, and grounded stance protocols to halt the dorsal collapse, quiet the internal critic, and release chronic unworthiness. It is time to uncurl your posture, claim your space, and belong.

books.title: The Phantom Alarm
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Calming Health Anxiety, Ending Body Hypervigilance, and Trusting Your Physical Health
books.hook: A chest flutter sends you down a midnight medical Google spiral.
books.hook_sub: You check your pulse on your smartwatch obsessively. Doctors say you're fine. But your body won't stop screaming.
books.description: Your nervous system misclassifies harmless biological noise as fatal emergencies. The Phantom Alarm delivers the definitive somatic roadmap to breaking interoceptive hypervigilance. Discover step-by-step resets to downshift racing heart rates, decouple physical sensations from catastrophic stories, and end compulsive symptom checking. Stop treating your body like a ticking bomb.

books.title: The Social Hangover
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Calming Post-Event Rumination, Ending the Replay Loop, and Reclaiming Your Social Battery
books.hook: You get home after a party and your brain launches a midnight autopsy of everything you said.
books.hook_sub: Aching jaw, drained mind, replaying every sentence. That's not introversion — it's a nervous system overload state.
books.description: The social hangover is an autonomic survival state caused by sensory saturation, social masking, and an unbudgeted nervous system. Tarun Mankar reveals why your brain replays conversations like a courtroom trial and delivers immediate physical protocols to discharge trapped tension, disarm cringe attacks, set unhurried departure anchors, and walk into any room with calm sovereignty.

books.title: The Braced Body
books.subtitle: A Somatic Guide to Releasing Chronic Physical Tension, Ending Muscle Armor, and Teaching Your Body It Is Safe to Unclench
books.hook: Even sitting quietly on your sofa, your body feels braced for a blow.
books.hook_sub: Clenched jaw, tight shoulders, held breath. That's not poor posture — it's your nervous system in fortress mode.
books.description: Chronic physical bracing is an evolutionary survival defense known as neuromuscular armoring. Willpower relaxation fails because the armoring is involuntary. Tarun Mankar delivers immediate physical protocols to dissolve muscle armor at the root — through pandicular resets, jaw and suboccipital de-armoring, and vagal safety anchors — to retrain sensorimotor amnesia.

books.title: The Imposter Alarm
books.subtitle: A Body-First Guide to Silencing the Fear of Being Exposed, Ending Over-Preparation, and Grounding in Real Competence
books.hook: Walking into meetings, your throat tightens and stomach drops into a sick knot of dread.
books.hook_sub: You live in private terror that you're a fraud waiting to be unmasked. Telling yourself to relax fails — you can't think your way out of a survival reflex.
books.description: Imposter syndrome is not a lack of confidence — it is an ancient evolutionary survival alarm. Professional visibility and social evaluation register as mortal tribal threats to your nervous system. This body-first manual delivers pre-meeting exposure resets, over-preparation boundaries, vocal laryngeal releases, and authority grounding anchors to rewire your nervous system.

books.title: The Calm Alarm
books.subtitle: A Body-First Guide to Calming Anticipatory Dread, Releasing the 'Other Shoe' Panic, and Allowing Yourself to Feel Safe When Life Is Good
books.hook: Life is going well — and that's exactly what terrifies you.
books.hook_sub: Every good day feels borrowed. Your stomach knots waiting for the other shoe to drop. To a nervous system built for chaos, sudden peace feels like an ambush.
books.description: Cherophobia and peace-triggered anxiety are ancient evolutionary threat alarms. To a nervous system conditioned by chronic turmoil, sudden quiet registers as an imminent ambush. Tarun Mankar reveals practical somatic protocols to calm anticipatory dread at the biological root — through seated table anchors, horizon resets, chaos impulse intercepts, and somatosensory trust pendulation.
